title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十二章 怪蟒云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十一章 吹笛
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
王允真见他过耳不忘，吹得分毫不差，又是佩服又是欢喜，听到入神处，想起母亲，泪珠更忍不住夺眶涌出。生怕被他察觉，急忙又伸手擦拭，忽然想起手中空空荡荡，“啊”地失声低呼，道：“糟了，笛子不见啦”
她打开火折子，惶急地转身四顾。
许宣眼尖，瞥见那枝玉犀短笛卡在洞壁的石隙里，笑道：“找到啦。”拾起笛子，转身正欲递给她，只见她举着火折子，惊骇无已地望着自己身后，张圆了嘴巴，却一声也发不出来。
他心中一沉，忽听身后传来一声低沉恐怖的怪吼狂飚鼓舞，还不等转身，腰上一紧，已被一个腥滑冰冷的东西缠住，猛然拔地卷起，“砰”头顶重重地撞在洞顶，金星乱舞，痛得几欲晕厥。
火光摇曳，泪水迸涌，模模糊糊地望见下方洞角盘蜷着一个金光闪闪的怪物。定睛细看，头皮发炸，冷汗瞬间沁满了全身。
那怪物乍一看是八条巨蟒交错盘缠，仔细分辨，居然是一条长了八个脑袋、分叉出八条蛇尾的巨大妖蟒
妖蟒八头八尾交缠在一起，每条蛇身至少都有两人来粗，五丈来长，金鳞闪闪，背上布满了绿色的青苔和荆棘，几乎挤占了整个洞窟。八个蛇头摇曳伸缩，全都张着血盆大口，龇牙吐信，鲜红如血的眼睛凶暴地瞪着他，作势欲扑
被火光照耀，八条影子投映在石壁上，忽大忽小，忽短忽长，显得尤为狰狞可怖。
王允真显然也从未见过这等怪物，骇得目瞪口呆，眼见巨蟒蛇尾缠住许宣，不住地往顶壁猛撞，才如梦初醒，高声大叫：“救……”话音未起，“呼”地一声，已被另一条蛇尾缠住腰腹，凌空拔起，透不过气来。
八头巨蟒咧嘴吐信，发出低沉的呜吼，就像在对着他们狞笑，收起蛇尾，慢慢地将他们卷向那八只争相扑冲的蛇头。
那八张血盆大口越来越近，腥臭扑鼻，许宣惊怒交迸，奈何蟒身越勒越紧，憋闷窒息，发不出任何声音。目光扫处，心中又是猛地一沉，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
小青
那八头巨蟒盘缠着的蛇身中央，赫然缠卷着一个绿衣女子，俏脸涨红，满是惊恼气恨的神色，竟是小青
这八头怪蟒究竟是何方神圣？难道竟是三十三山遣来追杀小青的怪物？既是如此，为何不卷着小青径直逃走，或索性将她吞入肚里，反倒藏在这洞窟之中？为何当他与王允真无意撞入时，依旧悄无声息地蜷在洞角？
许宣心中惊疑迭闪，不及多想，缠住王允真的蛇身突然将她往壁上一甩，撞得晕迷不醒，而后立即松开，朝他闪电似的卷来。几在同时，另外六条蛇尾也争先恐后地抛甩而至，将他从头到脚缠了个严严实实。
许宣眼前一黑，什么也瞧不见了，胸口突然一麻，剧痛彻骨，接着后背、头顶腰腹、大腿……全都如遭电击，疼得他全身收紧，直欲爆炸。虽然目不视物，却能清晰地感觉到妖蟒的八条蛇尾上长着涡形的锯齿吸盘，死死地咬住了他的八处穴位，就仿佛婴儿吮吸着母乳，贪婪地鼓动抽吸。
他的心中陡然闪过一个难以置信的念头，难道这八头八身的妖蟒是想吞吸他体内的真？
那妖蟒八头嘶嘶狞笑，他越是挣扎，蛇身越发蜷紧，吸盘的也如八股漩涡，越吸越快，将他体内的真气源源不断地抽去。
就在他惊怖绝望之际，丹田内忽然一震，急速飞旋。吸住他腹部的蛇尾顿时一阵抽搐，猛烈甩动。接着后背、头顶上的蛇尾也发狂似的摇摆起来，似乎想要松开吸盘，却抽离不出。
三条蛇身一松，许宣如释重负，猛地吸了口长气，只觉丹田内的气旋越转越快，奇经八脉瞬间贯通，“嘭嘭”连震，又有两条蛇尾剧烈抖动，仿佛有滚滚热流正从这五条蛇尾的吸盘冲入他的经脉，卷入丹田。

妖蟒八头乱舞，蛇身簌簌乱抖，方才的嘶嘶狞笑已变成了狂乱骇怒的咆哮。许宣又惊又奇，旋即恍然醒悟。
盗丹大法
他虽只修炼了二十多天的“盗丹心诀”，尚不知道如何盗取他人真元，却已渐渐习惯了“因时因地，相生真气”，按照时辰与所处之地的阴阳五行来炼转周身真气;也习惯了“虚空丹田，气注各脉”，将丹田内的“金丹真”转注入奇经八脉。就连睡觉之时，真也自动依循五行相生的顺序，缓慢流转，贮存在经脉各处。
这八头巨蟒若是只想将他勒毙，或是只抽吸他经络里的真，倒也罢了，偏偏将吸盘对准了他的丹田。
被这妖蟒巨力猛吸，许宣原本就空空荡荡的丹田霎时“真空”。丹田与全身经络相连，在巨大的“差”带动下，经脉内的真立即反向倒涌，环绕着丹田滚滚飞转，形成了漩涡。
content_en:
Wang Yunzhen saw that he had never forgotten what he had heard, and his playing skills were perfect. He was admired and happy at the same time. He was so entranced when he heard it, and when he thought of his mother, he couldn't help but burst into tears. Afraid of being noticed by him, I hurriedly stretched out my hand to wipe it again. Suddenly I remembered that my hands were empty. I whispered "Ah" and said, "Oh no, the flute is missing."
She opened the book and turned around anxiously.
Xu Xuan's sharp eyes caught a glimpse of the jade rhinoceros piccolo stuck in the stone crevice of the cave wall, and he smiled and said, "I found it." He picked up the flute, turned around and was about to hand it to her, when he saw her holding up the flute, looking behind her in horror, her mouth wide open, but no sound came out.
His heart sank, and suddenly he heard a low and terrifying roar coming from behind him. Before he could turn around, his waist tightened, and something slippery and cold was wrapped around his waist. It was suddenly pulled up and rolled up. "Bang", his head hit the roof of the cave heavily. Venus danced wildly, and he almost fainted from the pain.
The firelight flickered, tears welled up, and he vaguely saw a golden monster curled up in the corner of the cave below. Looking closely, my scalp was on fire and cold sweat instantly covered my body.
At first glance, the monster looked like eight giant pythons intertwined. However, upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a giant monster python with eight heads and eight forked tails.
The demonic pythons had eight heads and eight tails intertwined together. Each snake was at least two people thick and five feet long, with shining golden scales. Its back was covered with green moss and thorns, almost occupying the entire cave. The eight snake heads swayed and retracted, all with their mouths wide open, baring their teeth and spitting out messages. Their bright red eyes stared at him fiercely, ready to pounce.
Illuminated by the fire, eight shadows were projected on the stone wall, sometimes big and sometimes small, sometimes short and sometimes long, looking particularly ferocious and terrifying.
Wang Yunzhen had obviously never seen such a monster before, and was stunned with horror. He saw the giant python's tail wrapped around Xu Xuan, and kept slamming against the top wall. He woke up as if from a dream, and shouted loudly: "Help..." Before he could speak, another snake's tail was wrapped around his waist and abdomen, and he was pulled up in the air, suffocating him.
The eight-headed giant python grinned and spat out a message, letting out a low roar, as if it was grinning at them. It retracted its tail and slowly rolled them towards the eight heads of the snake that were fighting each other.
The eight bloody mouths were getting closer and closer, and the stench hit his nostrils. Xu Xuan was frightened and angry, but the python's body tightened tighter and tighter, suffocating and unable to make any sound. Looking everywhere, his heart suddenly sank again, he couldn't believe his eyes.
Xiaoqing
In the middle of the body of the eight-headed giant python, a woman in green clothes was suddenly entangled. Her pretty face turned red and she looked full of surprise and anger. It was Xiao Qing.
Who is this eight-headed monster python? Could it be that it was a monster sent by Thirty-Three Mountains to hunt down Xiaoqing? If that's the case, why not just run away with Xiaoqing, or simply swallow her, instead hiding in this cave? Why did he and Wang Yunzhen still huddle quietly in the corner of the cave when they accidentally bumped into it?
Xu Xuan's heart was filled with doubts. Without thinking much, the snake wrapped around Wang Yunzhen and suddenly threw her against the wall, knocking her unconscious. Then she immediately let go and rolled towards him like lightning. Almost at the same time, six other snake tails rushed towards him, wrapping him tightly from head to toe.
Xu Xuan's vision went dark and he couldn't see anything. His chest suddenly went numb, and the pain was bone-piercing. Then his back, head, waist, abdomen, thighs... everything felt like an electric shock. The pain made his whole body tighten, and he was about to explode. Although he couldn't see anything, he could clearly feel that the eight snake tails of the demon python had spiral serrated suckers, biting his eight acupuncture points, just like a baby sucking breast milk, greedily pumping and pumping.
An unbelievable thought suddenly flashed through his mind. Could it be that these demonic pythons with eight heads and eight bodies wanted to swallow the truth inside him?
The eight heads of the demonic python hissed and laughed ferociously. The more he struggled, the more tightly the snake's body curled up. The suckers were like eight whirlpools, sucking faster and faster, sucking out the true energy from his body.
Just when he was terrified and desperate, there was a sudden shock in Dantian, spinning rapidly. The snake's tail sucking his abdomen suddenly twitched and swung violently. Then the snake's tail on the back and on the top of the head also swayed like crazy, as if it wanted to loosen the suction cup, but couldn't.
As soon as the three snakes were loosened, Xu Xuan felt relieved and took a long breath. He felt that the cyclone in his Dantian was turning faster and faster, and the eight extraordinary meridians were instantly connected. There were "bang bang" vibrations, and two more snake tails shook violently. It was as if a billowing heat flow was rushing into his meridians from the suction cups of the five snake tails, and was involved in the Dantian.
The eight heads of the demon python were dancing wildly, the snake's body was shaking wildly, and the hissing smile just now had turned into a wild and terrifying roar. Xu Xuan was shocked and surprised, and then suddenly realized.
Stealing elixirs
Although he has only practiced the "Stealing Pill Heart Technique" for more than 20 days and does not yet know how to steal other people's true energy, he has gradually become accustomed to "generating true energy according to time and place" and refining the true energy around the body according to the yin and yang and the five elements of the time and place; he is also used to "voiding the Dantian and injecting Qi into each channel" and transferring the "Golden Elixir True" in the Dantian into the eight extraordinary meridians. Even when sleeping, the truth automatically follows the order of the five elements, slowly circulates, and is stored in various meridians.
If these eight giant pythons just wanted to strangle him to death, or just suck out the essence in his meridians, that would be fine, but they aimed their suction cups at his Dantian.
Being sucked fiercely by the monster python, Xu Xuan's originally empty Dantian became "vacuum" in an instant. The Dantian is connected to the meridians of the whole body. Driven by the huge "difference", the true energy in the meridians immediately surges backwards, rolling around the Dantian, forming a vortex.
